description: This file defines a PluginAdapter for WebSocket communication in a Mattermost plugin, including methods for managing WebSocket connections, broadcasting updates, and handling cluster events.

classes.name: PluginAdapter
classes.description: Implements WebSocket communication and broadcasting logic for the plugin.

methods.name: NewPluginAdapter
methods.description: Constructor for PluginAdapter, initializes internal maps and mutexes.

methods.name: GetListenerByWebConnID
methods.description: Retrieves a listener by WebSocket connection ID.

methods.name: GetListenersByUserID
methods.description: Retrieves all listeners associated with a user ID.

methods.name: GetListenersByTeam
methods.description: Retrieves all listeners subscribed to a team.

methods.name: GetListenersByBlock
methods.description: Retrieves all listeners subscribed to a block.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Adds a new listener to internal maps.

methods.name: removeListener
methods.description: Removes a listener and its subscriptions.

methods.name: removeExpiredForUserID
methods.description: Removes expired and inactive listeners for a user.

methods.name: removeListenerFromTeam
methods.description: Removes a listener from a team subscription.

methods.name: removeListenerFromBlock
methods.description: Removes a listener from a block subscription.

methods.name: subscribeListenerToTeam
methods.description: Subscribes a listener to a team.

methods.name: unsubscribeListenerFromTeam
methods.description: Unsubscribes a listener from a team.

methods.name: getUserIDsForTeam
methods.description: Returns user IDs with active listeners for a team who have access.

methods.name: getUserIDsForTeamAndBoard
methods.description: Returns user IDs with active listeners for a team and board, optionally ensuring specific user IDs.

methods.name: OnWebSocketConnect
methods.description: Handles new WebSocket connection, reusing or creating listeners.

methods.name: OnWebSocketDisconnect
methods.description: Handles WebSocket disconnection, marking listener inactive.

methods.name: commandFromRequest
methods.description: Parses WebSocket request into command structure.

methods.name: WebSocketMessageHasBeenPosted
methods.description: Processes posted WebSocket messages, handling subscription commands.

methods.name: sendMessageToAll
methods.description: Broadcasts a message to all WebSocket clients.

methods.name: BroadcastConfigChange
methods.description: Broadcasts configuration changes to all clients.

methods.name: sendUserMessageSkipCluster
methods.description: Sends a message to specific users, skipping cluster propagation.

methods.name: sendTeamMessageSkipCluster
methods.description: Sends a message to all users in a team, skipping cluster.

methods.name: sendTeamMessage
methods.description: Sends and propagates a message to team subscribers.

methods.name: sendBoardMessageSkipCluster
methods.description: Sends a message to users subscribed to a team and board, skipping cluster.

methods.name: sendBoardMessage
methods.description: Sends and propagates a message to board subscribers.

methods.name: BroadcastBlockChange
methods.description: Broadcasts a block change event.

methods.name: BroadcastCategoryChange
methods.description: Broadcasts a category change event.

methods.name: BroadcastCategoryReorder
methods.description: Broadcasts a category reorder event.

methods.name: BroadcastCategoryBoardsReorder
methods.description: Broadcasts a category's boards reorder event.

methods.name: BroadcastCategoryBoardChange
methods.description: Broadcasts a change in category boards.

methods.name: BroadcastBlockDelete
methods.description: Broadcasts a block deletion event.

methods.name: BroadcastBoardChange
methods.description: Broadcasts a board change event.

methods.name: BroadcastBoardDelete
methods.description: Broadcasts a board deletion event.

methods.name: BroadcastMemberChange
methods.description: Broadcasts a member change event.

methods.name: BroadcastMemberDelete
methods.description: Broadcasts a member deletion event.

methods.name: BroadcastSubscriptionChange
methods.description: Broadcasts a subscription change event.

methods.name: BroadcastCardLimitTimestampChange
methods.description: Broadcasts a change in card limit timestamp.
